remarks: Your Next Chapter Begins Here! Welcome to this beautiful 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath Townhouse-style Condo in the heart of Alhambra, where comfort, convenience, and modern living come together. Just steps from downtown’s vibrant dining and shopping, this inviting home features a sun-filled, expansive living room with a cozy fireplace and a spectacular wrap-around patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The grand formal dining room offers an elegant setting for family dinners and memorable gatherings. The warm, inviting kitchen features a half island and built-in appliances.
